requirement_baseline.FR-CLK-003: QSPI 12.5 MHz (core/4) or 50 MHz DDR, configurable
requirement_baseline.FR-CLK-005: Per-peripheral clock enable via power-domain controller
requirement_baseline.ARC-006: 50 MHz core, 25 MHz periph, 32 kHz LPO (PROPOSED)

options.name: Single 50 MHz domain with clock enables
options.description: All logic runs on 50 MHz; peripherals receive qualified enables. No generated clock, no AON.
options.functional_correctness: Works for digital function, but peripheral timing (UART divisor, PWM range, timer tick) is 2x the specified rate. Violates FR-CLK-002 and FR-CLK-004.
options.clock_tree: One tree; simplest CTS and STA.
options.cdc: None internally; only pin-level async inputs.
options.reset: One reset domain; existing reset_ctrl reusable.
options.power: Clock gating only; no 32 kHz sleep timer; deep sleep below 1 mW not achievable without external always-on timer.
options.gating: Existing core/periph gate structure reusable; per-peripheral enables still missing.
options.verification: Lowest; existing 22/22 suite applies almost unchanged.
options.firmware: No divisor changes; current firmware remains valid, but product requirements are unmet.
options.scalability: Poor: adding a real 25 MHz domain later changes every peripheral and constraint.
options.verdict: Not compliant; acceptable only as a formally approved descope.

options.name: 50 MHz core + synchronous /2 25 MHz peripheral clock
options.description: Internal divider generates clk_periph = clk_core/2. APB peripherals run at 25 MHz; core, memories and AXI run at 50 MHz.
options.functional_correctness: Meets FR-CLK-002. Requires UART divisor, timer, PWM, SPI, I2C, I2S scaling review and firmware updates.
options.clock_tree: Two synchronous trees from one source; CTS must balance each; 25 MHz tree is half rate.
options.cdc: Core/periph crossing is synchronous (same source, divide-by-2) but still needs a safe APB bridge handshake; no metastability, but phase relationship must be constrained.
options.reset: Per-domain reset release synchronizers required; existing single reset insufficient.
options.constraints: create_clock 50 MHz + create_generated_clock divide_by 2; cross-domain exceptions/handshake paths; QSPI divider.
options.power: Peripheral tree can be gated independently; still no 32 kHz AON.
options.gating: Core and periph gates exist; per-peripheral enables still required by FR-CLK-005.
options.physical: Moderate: generated clock, two trees, phase-aware CTS.
options.verification: Moderate: new CDC/handshake checks, peripheral frequency tests.
options.firmware: Baud/timer/PWM constants must change from 50 to 25 MHz for APB peripherals.
options.verdict: Recommended minimum compliant baseline if AON is descoped.

options.name: 50 MHz core + 25 MHz peripheral + independent 32 kHz AON
options.description: As B, plus an always-on 32.768 kHz domain for LPTIM, wake control and sticky power state. AON clock sourced from an external 32.768 kHz crystal/oscillator pin (no unqualified on-chip RC).
options.functional_correctness: Meets FR-CLK-002 and FR-CLK-004; enables real deep sleep and wake timers.
options.clock_tree: Three trees: 50 MHz, 25 MHz, 32 kHz; AON tree must be minimal and placed in the AON region.
options.cdc: True asynchronous core<->AON and periph<->AON crossings; requires 2-FF synchronizers, handshakes and reset synchronizers; APB access to AON registers needs a bridge.
options.reset: Three reset domains, async assert / sync deassert per domain; AON reset from POR only.
options.constraints: Three clock definitions, generated 25 MHz, async clock groups, AON false paths and max-delay constraints.
options.power: Enables AON-only sleep; core/periph can be clock- or power-gated.
options.gating: Per-domain and per-peripheral gating; AON never gated.
options.physical: Highest: AON placement, isolation, separate tree, CTS corners.
options.verification: Highest: CDC formal, AON wake sequences, reset-domain checks.
options.firmware: 25 MHz peripheral constants plus AON timer/wake driver.
options.scalability: Best; supports the specified low-power product.
options.verdict: Recommended production architecture. Highest effort; requires power intent (see power report).

options.name: External multi-output clock generator (Si5351) for 50 MHz, 25 MHz and 32.768 kHz
options.description: Si5351 provides three board-level clocks; SoC receives separate clk_core, clk_periph and clk_aon pins.
options.functional_correctness: Meets frequencies, but core and peripheral become asynchronous, so every APB transaction crosses a clock domain.
options.clock_tree: Three independent trees; CTS simpler per tree but no synchronous relationship.
options.cdc: Worst: full async handshake/FIFO required in the APB bridge for every access.
options.reset: Three async domains; full reset synchronization.
options.constraints: Three unrelated clocks, async groups, heavy exceptions.
options.power: Board generator consumes power even in sleep; AON clock available.
options.physical: Moderate SoC, higher board complexity and three clock pins.
options.external_hw: Si5351 with three outputs; more pins and board cost.
options.scalability: Flexible but adds permanent board dependency.
options.verdict: Not recommended: asynchronous 50/25 crossing is strictly worse than an internal synchronous divider.

recommendation.short_name: C-prime: 50 MHz core, internal /2 25 MHz peripheral, external 32.768 kHz AON

clock_sources.core: External 50.000 MHz LVCMOS oscillator or Si5351 CLK0 into clk_core
clock_sources.qspi_sck: Generated inside QSPI controller from clk_core; divided to <=25 MHz for first silicon

recommendation.divider: clk_periph = clk_core / 2 (toggle flop), 50% duty by construction

ownership.clk_core: core, AXI fabric, memories, QSPI controller, JTAG TAP logic
ownership.clk_periph: APB bridge slave side and all APB peripherals
ownership.clk_aon: LPTIM, wake controller, PMU sticky state, reset stretcher

recommendation.reset_strategy: Asynchronous assert, synchronous deassert per domain; AON reset only from POR; core reset also from watchdog/PMU; peripheral reset from core domain request synchronized into clk_periph.
recommendation.clock_gating: Core gate and periph gate retained; add per-peripheral enables in clk_periph domain; AON ungated.

power_states.SLEEP: Core and peripheral clocks gated, AON on, state retained
power_states.DEEP: Core/peripheral rail off via PMIC, AON on, context saved to AON-retained registers or external flash

recommendation.firmware_impact: APB peripheral constants change from 50 MHz to 25 MHz; UART divisor doubles; timer/PWM/I2C/SPI/I2S scaling updated; AON driver added. Core and memory timing unchanged.
recommendation.verification_impact: Add generated-clock STA, APB handshake assertions, AON wake formal, reset-domain checks.
recommendation.physical_impact: Two synchronous clock trees plus a small AON tree; generated clock must be defined in CTS and STA.

approval.approved_option: C-prime: 50 MHz core, internal /2 25 MHz peripheral, external 32.768 kHz AON, no on-chip PLL
approval.technical_consequence: Adopt C-prime as the approved Stage 1 clock architecture.
approval.risks: Additional CDC, reset, clock-tree, firmware and board-level integration complexity.
approval.dependencies: ARC-036, ARC-065, TD-005 and TD-010 require separate approval.
acceptance_criteria: ARC-006 rewritten with option C-prime and approved by owner
FR-CLK-002 and FR-CLK-004 either retained with implementation plan or formally descoped
One SDC clock plan (50/25/32k) signed off
AON source (external 32.768 kHz) accepted at board level
